key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:09BA
name: copy_record_fields_to_slot
description: When a status check reports success, it runs five helper calls and then copies three 16-bit fields of the input record into one of eight slots in two parallel tables. The slot is chosen from a counter value held in a shared variable.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:0A0E
name: advance_tracked_object_state
description: Bumps a frame counter toward a limit, computes a scaled step from two lookup tables and a divisor, and adds it to the record's position-like field. It also updates a velocity-like field and decrements a countdown; if a check fails or a second record's countdown has gone negative, it saves the record's state to shared storage and returns a failure code.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:0A20
name: select_nearest_target_and_update
description: When the record's tracking field is negative, it tries a fixed number of candidate entries through a test routine and keeps the one with the smallest offset. Otherwise it steps the record's position and velocity through lookup tables, and when a further check passes it saves three fields to shared storage and returns a status code.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:0A6E
name: copy_record_on_two_checks
description: Runs two test routines and only when the first returns nonzero and the second returns zero does it run five calls and copy three 16-bit fields of the record into shared state.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:0A78
name: advance_object_or_copy_fields
description: If the first test passes it runs a range test and, on success, copies three fields of the record into shared state. Otherwise it decays a countdown field, bumps a counter, steps position and velocity from lookup tables, and saves the state to shared storage when a closing test fails.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:0AB0
name: copy_record_when_check_passes
description: When a single test routine returns zero, it runs five calls and copies three 16-bit fields of the record into shared state.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:0B0A
name: clamp_step_and_test_range
description: Computes a clamped step from the difference between a record position and a reference value and applies it to two stored fields. If a follow-up check passes and the result lies within a limit derived from the record, it saves the record's three fields to a shared slot and returns a success code.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:0B1C
name: clamp_step_and_apply
description: Clamps a step to the negative of a limit value, scales it by a divisor and adds it to a stored position field. It then applies an offset based on a second field and, when a check passes and the sum fits within a range limit, saves the record's state and returns a success code.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:0B58
name: update_field_and_record_hit
description: Clamps a step against a negative bound, adds a scaled value to a record field, then runs a test. When the test passes and a sum of two inputs stays within the record's limit, it saves the record's three fields to shared storage and returns a success code.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:0B7A
name: store_record_if_in_range
description: Takes the absolute value of one input and adds it to a second input. If the total stays within a limit derived from the record, it saves the record's three fields to shared storage and returns a success code; otherwise it returns zero.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:0BC0
name: call_record_handler_pointer
description: Calls the function pointer stored at a fixed offset of the record it is given. The routine has no other logic.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:0BC6
name: update_record_and_queue_event
description: Sets a timeout value on the record, then either steps its position and velocity from lookup tables under a callback check and range test or advances its position directly. When the range test succeeds it saves three fields to shared storage, appends an event entry to a queue and returns a code.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:0D72
name: decay_and_step_object
description: Reduces a decay field when it is positive, increments a counter toward a limit, and steps position and velocity from lookup tables. It decrements a countdown, and when a test fails or a second field is negative it saves the record's state to shared storage and returns a failure code.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:0D8A
name: step_object_position_and_velocity
description: Increments a counter toward a limit, derives a step from a lookup table and a divisor, and adds it to position and velocity fields of the record. It decrements a countdown, and when a test fails or a second field is negative it saves the state to shared storage and returns a failure code.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:0EC2
name: arm_target_when_in_window
description: Sets a status word to 10. When a shared gate is clear and the record's position lies within a window around a reference value, it sets the status word to 3 and, if a second position is also near, writes a marker byte into the shared handler slot.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:0F04
name: arm_target_when_band_exceeded
description: Sets a status word to 13 when a shared gate is clear and the record's position lies outside a band centred on a reference value. If a second position is also near, it writes a marker byte into the shared handler slot.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:0F5A
name: flag_band_exceeded_status_four
description: Sets a status word to 4 when the record's position lies outside a band centred on a reference value. If a second position is also near, it writes a marker byte into the shared handler slot.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:0FA8
name: install_record_callback_once
description: If a flag bit on the record is clear, it sets that bit, stores a handler reference in the record and saves three of its words in shared storage. It then clears status bits on a linked record and, when a saved identity matches the current one, writes a marker to the shared handler slot and resets the identity.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:103E
name: mark_record_active_in_slot
description: Sets an active bit in the record's flags and clears its counter unless the bit is already set, in which case it returns -1. It stores the record in one of two shared slots depending on which slot it matches, updates a state value, and returns 0.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:1168
name: advance_counter_and_set_state
description: When a state value is zero, it adds one plus a shared step counter to an accumulator, calls a routine and sets a status byte to 14. Otherwise it does nothing.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:118E
name: test_position_band_hit
description: When a size-scaled field is at or below the input value, it measures the record's position against a reference and shifts that distance by a fixed amount. It returns zero when the result lies inside a threshold derived from a shared value, and -1 otherwise.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:11AC
name: test_offset_distance_threshold
description: Measures the record's position against a reference, offsets the distance by a fixed amount and compares it with a threshold derived from a shared value. It returns zero when the distance passes and -1 otherwise.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:11D6
name: test_range_outside_window
description: When a size-scaled field is at or below the input value and the record's position lies more than a fixed distance from a reference, it returns zero. Otherwise it returns -1.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:11F4
name: test_distance_beyond_limit
description: Returns zero when the record's position lies more than a fixed distance from a reference value, and -1 when it lies within that distance.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:120A
name: tick_record_countdowns
description: Walks the table of object records and skips inactive ones. For each active record it decrements a countdown, reloading it from a value derived from a shared constant and the record's position when it reaches zero, and sets a flag bit on records whose countdown is at a specific count while a shared value is negative.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:1280
name: spawn_entry_into_free_slot
description: Converts a test result into a score-like code and stores a snapshot of the input record when it is nonzero. If a shared firing condition holds and a free entry exists in the shared table, it copies the record's position, velocity and state into that entry and increments a shared counter. The routine calls several helpers and returns a code when it spawns.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:146A
name: compute_scaled_range_value
description: Returns zero when the record's status counter is zero or minus one. Otherwise it calls a routine and returns a value scaled from two record fields and a shared value.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:14B6
name: run_update_over_records
description: Saves a shared flag into a companion slot and clears the original. It then loops over the object records, calling the update handler stored in each record.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:14E8
name: select_closest_active_target
description: When the active record count is below a limit and a timing check passes, it scans the records whose flag bits mark them active and keeps the one with the smallest computed distance. If it finds one, it records the current timer value and calls two routines.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:1576
name: step_seeking_object_and_retarget
description: Ramps a timer field toward a fixed value and updates velocity-like and position fields from lookup tables and a clamped correction term. When an expiry counter reaches zero it switches the record's handler and selects the nearest eligible record as its target.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:15DE
name: approach_target_or_arm_record
description: Computes the distance from the record to its linked record and sets a closing speed from it. When that distance is below a small threshold it resets the motion fields, sets a flag bit and switches the record's handler. Otherwise it integrates position from lookup tables and runs the same expiry and selection checks as its neighbour.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:1678
name: run_cooldown_then_integrate
description: Counts a cooldown field down toward zero, or when it is already zero arms the record's handler and flags. It integrates position and velocity from lookup tables, runs an expiry countdown and, when distance and timing tests pass, copies the record into a free entry of the shared table.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:169A
name: arm_motion_handlers_when_late
description: Clears one set of flag bits and, when a shared frame counter is past a limit, sets another set of flags and installs the record's handlers. It then integrates position and velocity from lookup tables.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:16B6
name: arm_and_integrate_motion
description: Sets flag bits and installs the record's handlers, then integrates position and velocity from lookup tables using a clamped correction term.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:16D0
name: adjust_speed_then_integrate
description: Raises a speed-like field when it is below a threshold, clears another field, and integrates position and velocity from lookup tables. When a second value is below its limit it steps the field upward.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:16DE
name: accelerate_then_integrate
description: Raises a speed-like field when a value is under a limit, clears a timer, and integrates position and velocity from lookup tables. It also resets the record's handler when it is not under the limit.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:1708
name: clear_flag_and_integrate_motion
description: Clears one flag bit and installs a new handler on the record, then integrates position and velocity from lookup tables.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:1718
name: update_record_targeting_state
description: Advances a timer field toward a fixed value and, while a shared counter is below a limit, compares the record's position fields with a candidate record. When the offsets fall within limits it recomputes scaled values and stores them in shared table entries.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:1904
name: integrate_motion_with_input_step
description: Chooses a step value from an input word and a shared timer bit, clamps it, and applies it to the record's velocity and position through lookup tables, then stores the new fields.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:1940
name: integrate_motion_from_input_word
description: Derives a step from an input word, clamps it against the record's limits, and applies it to the record's velocity and position through lookup tables.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:1960
name: update_record_with_slot_search
description: Clears status bits and installs a handler on the record when a shared timing value is in range. It then runs a loop over a fixed number of slots, stopping early when a distance test fails, and integrates the record's position and velocity from lookup tables.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:197C
name: advance_record_and_search_slots
description: Clears status bits and installs a handler when a shared timing value is in range, then loops over a fixed number of slots and stops when a distance test fails. It finishes by integrating position and velocity from lookup tables.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:1A14
name: scan_records_out_of_range
description: Counts a loop value down over the record table, calling a distance test on each entry until the result leaves a window. It then integrates the record's position and velocity from lookup tables when a countdown field is below its limit.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:1A1E
name: reset_handler_and_clear_flags
description: Installs a new handler on the record, clears a set of status bits and zeroes a countdown field.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:1A32
name: compute_scaled_offset_from_field
description: Calls three routines and returns the difference between the input value and a field of the record, shifted right by five bits.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:1A6A
name: stub_empty_routine_body
description: The routine body contains only a return and no recoverable behaviour, so it has no logic to describe.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:1A7A
name: integrate_motion_when_not_locked
description: When a status bit is clear it derives a step from an input value and a shared scale, otherwise it uses a fixed step. It clamps the result and integrates position and velocity from lookup tables.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:1A88
name: integrate_motion_from_input_x
description: Derives a step from an input value and the record's limits, clamps it, and integrates position and velocity from lookup tables.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:1A98
name: clamp_input_and_integrate_motion
description: Clamps an input value to the negative of a bound, then integrates the record's position and velocity from lookup tables.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:1AB0
name: clamp_input_and_integrate_position
description: Clamps an input value to the negative of a bound and applies it to the record's position, then runs the lookup table integration on velocity and position.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:1AF0
name: integrate_clamped_motion_with_checks
description: Clamps a step against a bound, updates the record's position and velocity from lookup tables, and runs a series of checks that adjust the record's status and timing fields.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:1E7E
name: retire_record_into_free_list
description: When the record's countdown is not positive, it clears status bits, installs a new handler, saves its three fields into a shared slot and unlinks it from a shared list. Otherwise it clamps a step and applies it to the record.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:1F02
name: initialise_record_from_source
description: Sets a record's position and velocity fields from a source record and a shared value, choosing different offsets and status constants depending on a flag bit in the source. It then sets status bits, installs a handler and runs a scan of the active records.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:1FFA
name: update_scale_and_frame_timers
description: Derives a shared scale value from a counter clamped to a range, halved when a flag is set, and recomputes dependent values. It then calls a series of routines, decrements countdowns and advances a frame counter.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:20D4
name: decrement_pending_counters_guarded
description: Decrements two shared counters when they are nonzero. The routine has no other logic.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:20D8
name: decrement_pending_counters
description: Decrements two shared counters when they are nonzero.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:20F6
name: age_and_remove_nearby_records
description: Walks the shared record table, decrementing the lifetime of each active record and moving it by its velocity. A record whose distance to a reference point drops under a threshold is cleared, and a second pass handles the remaining slots.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:22C2
name: drift_slots_and_emit_marker
description: When a flag is negative it advances eight shared slot records by fixed increments. When a timing mask is met it copies a source record into a slot with a fixed status value.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:234C
name: decay_shared_velocity_pair
description: When one shared value is positive and another is above a lower bound, it lowers the second value by a fixed step and adds it into the first.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:2372
name: store_marker_and_notify
description: Writes an index byte to a shared slot, stores two words from shared values into the table and then calls a routine.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:23A2
name: clamp_shared_velocities_and_dispatch
description: Clamps two shared velocity-like values to fixed limits, then dispatches to a sequence of routines depending on state flags. It computes a timing offset from an input word and a shared counter.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:2466
name: snapshot_values_and_clamp_records
description: Copies four shared values into a snapshot block, then raises a timing field of each active record to at least a value derived from a shared counter.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:24B6
name: find_nearest_flagged_record
description: Scans the record table for entries whose flag bits match a selection mask and keeps the one with the smallest combined offset from a shared reference point. It stores that record in a shared slot.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:259C
name: clear_marker_and_query_record

description: Clips a segment against rectangular bounds using region codes for both endpoints, moving endpoints onto the edges and returning a code that records which edges were crossed.

description: When a shared queue has room, appends a five-byte entry holding the shared frame value, two sign bits taken from shared positions and two input bytes.

description: Copies bytes one at a time from a source pointer into a fixed shared buffer, advancing both pointers.

description: Copies bytes from a source pointer into a fixed shared buffer in a nested loop, advancing the destination pointer on each outer step.

name: format_three_digit_text
description: Writes a value below one thousand as hundreds, tens and units characters into a shared buffer and copies the text to the output.

description: Returns a position-like field of the record when a flag bit is clear. Otherwise it calls a routine and returns one of two shared values plus a fixed offset, chosen by that result.

name: or_masks_into_display_blocks
description: Ors a mask into many words of a display block at a stride, decrementing a shared countdown when it is positive, and writes the block to the output.

name: publish_state_block_when_idle
description: When a shared counter is zero, it copies a block of shared values into a fixed structure and then writes the values into its sub-blocks.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:713A

name: scale_word_and_swap_halves
description: Fetches a word through a routine, multiplies it by an input word and returns the 32-bit product with its two 16-bit halves exchanged.

description: Advances a shared 16-bit seed with a linear congruential step that multiplies it by 41 and adds 73.

description: When an input value is at most a shared limit and a counter is below six, it stores a timing value, the input value and an input pointer in shared storage.

name: find_matching_entry_alt_b
description: Searches the shared table backwards, one entry at a time, for an entry whose three key values equal shared values, stopping at the first match.

name: reset_state_and_link_buffer

description: Saves the current position and height into shared fields, resets a shared counter and calls two stored handlers.

name: format_text_into_buffer_alt
description: Clears a 48-byte shared text buffer to spaces, converts the text to uppercase and inserts a period when the text is too long.

name: set_timer_and_format_text
description: Sets a shared threshold to a default value unless a record value is larger, clears a flag, calls a routine and formats the result into the text buffer.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:897A
name: set_timer_default_and_format
description: Sets a shared threshold to a default value and clears a shared flag, then formats a value into the text buffer when it exceeds the threshold.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:89C0
name: decrement_shared_threshold
description: Clears a status byte in the record, subtracts a fixed amount from a shared value and sets a shared flag byte.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:89D8
name: initialise_shared_constants
description: When a shared value is nonzero, resets a block of shared constants to initial values and clears a display buffer region.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:89E4
name: initialise_timing_constants
description: Sets shared timing and scale constants to initial values, stores two table words and clears a display buffer region.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:8A46
name: raise_shared_level_capped
description: Raises a shared level value by five when it is under ten and by ten otherwise, capping it at one hundred. It then clears a status byte, resets a shared value and fills a display byte.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:8A56
name: set_level_from_input_capped
description: Sets a shared level to an input value plus ten, capped at one hundred, then clears a status byte and resets a shared value.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:8A7C
name: lower_shared_level_floored
description: Lowers a shared level by ten and floors it at zero, clearing a status byte when the floor is reached.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:8A96
name: set_shared_level_maximum
description: Sets a shared level to its maximum of one hundred, resets a shared value and clears a status byte.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:8AB6
name: clear_shared_level
description: Sets a shared level to zero and clears a status byte.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:8AC2
name: set_shared_level_to_constant
description: Sets a shared level to a fixed value of 144, resets a shared value and clears a status byte.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:8ADC
name: accumulate_shared_step_clamped
description: When a flag is set, adds a step that halves for each shift of a counter to a shared accumulator. When the accumulator passes a ceiling it is reduced and a status byte is cleared.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:8B12
name: decrease_shared_accumulator_floored
description: When a flag is set, subtracts a shift-scaled step from a shared accumulator and floors it at a fixed value, clearing a status byte when the floor is hit.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:8B48
name: accumulate_second_shared_step
description: When a flag is set, adds a shift-scaled step to a second shared accumulator and clears a status byte when it passes a ceiling.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:8B78
name: decrease_second_shared_accumulator
description: When a flag is set, subtracts a shift-scaled step from a second shared accumulator and floors it at a fixed value.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:8BB0
name: decay_shared_speed_and_count
description: Reduces a shared speed value by a quarter of itself, floored at 500, and increments a shared counter. When the counter is not ten it calls routines and scans the records.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:8BD6
name: scan_records_with_mask
description: Scans the record table for entries whose flag mask is clear and calls a routine for each, then calls two routines.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:8BDC
name: decay_shared_speed_floor
description: Reduces a shared speed value by a quarter of itself, floored at 500, and clears a status byte when the floor is reached.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:8C08
name: grow_shared_speed_capped
description: Raises a shared speed value by a quarter of itself, capped at 20000, and decrements a shared counter. When the counter is not one it calls routines and scans the records.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:8C2E
name: scan_records_with_mask_alt
description: Scans the record table for entries whose flag mask is clear and calls a routine for each, then calls two routines.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:8C34
name: grow_shared_speed_cap_alt
description: Raises a shared speed value by a quarter of itself, capped at 20000, and clears a status byte when the cap is reached.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:8C60
name: clear_buffer_and_run_handlers
description: Clears a status byte, sets a shared flag, fills 128 bytes of a record area with a fill value and clears a shared word. It then calls two stored handlers and resets the flag.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:8CB6
name: cycle_counter_and_format_line
description: Increments a shared counter and, when it reaches three, resets it and formats a value into the shared text buffer, calling a routine first.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:8CD8
name: format_text_line_from_value
description: Calls two routines, clears the shared text buffer to spaces and copies an uppercase text string into it, adding a period when the text is too long.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:8CEA
name: format_text_line_alt
description: Calls two routines, clears the shared text buffer to spaces and copies an uppercase text string into it, adding a period when the text is too long.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:8D30
name: set_mode_one_restore_word
description: Clears a status byte, sets a shared mode value to one and clears a flag, then calls routines and restores a saved shared word.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:8D6C
name: set_mode_zero_restore_word
description: Clears a status byte, sets a shared mode value to zero and clears a flag, then calls routines and restores a saved shared word.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:8DA6
name: set_mode_two_restore_word
description: Clears a status byte, sets a shared mode value to two and sets a flag, then calls routines and restores a saved shared word.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:8DDA
name: restore_shared_word_after_calls
description: Saves a shared word, calls routines and restores the word when a flag is set.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:8E56
name: load_three_pointers_and_call
description: Stores three words from a source block into shared slots, calling a routine after each one, and returns the two input values.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:8EE4
name: dispatch_handler_for_mode
description: Clears a status byte and sets a flag when a shared value is within a range and two gates are clear. It then calls the handler selected by a mode value for each record in a short loop.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:8F3E
name: spawn_entry_from_table_a
description: When a shared spawn count is nonzero it decrements the count, records it in a shared field and fills a new entry with values from a shared table and the current position.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:8F66
name: spawn_entry_from_table_b
description: When a shared spawn count is nonzero it decrements the count, records it in a shared field and fills a new entry with values from a second shared table and the current position.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:8F94
name: spawn_entry_from_table_c
description: When a shared spawn count is nonzero it decrements the count, records it in a shared field and fills a new entry with values from a third shared table and the current position.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:8FF2
name: initialise_entry_from_template
description: Fills an entry from a source template, scaling its first field by a shared value, copying further fields from the template and setting position, offset and status values from shared inputs.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:9086
name: toggle_flag_and_arm_counter
description: Clears a status byte, sets a display flag, toggles a shared flag and, when the toggled flag is zero, sets a shared countdown to one.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:90A4
name: toggle_flag_on_value_change
description: When a shared value differs from a reference and a timing value is above a limit, toggles a shared flag and sets a display flag.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:90CA
name: toggle_shared_flag_alt
description: Toggles a shared flag and sets a display flag.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:90DA
name: invert_shared_mask_bits
description: Inverts a shared bit mask and clears a status byte.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:90E6
name: update_slot_table_on_change
description: When a shared gate is set and a shared frame value has moved beyond a range, it marks the change and writes scaled values from shared inputs into a free entry of the slot table.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:929A
name: find_nearest_candidate_when_idle
description: When a shared busy flag is clear, scans the record table for the nearest candidate within a distance limit and stores the closest one in a shared slot after clearing a status byte.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:92AC
name: render_status_text_from_pointer
description: Returns its input pair unchanged when a shared pointer is null. Otherwise it calls a routine, clears a shared text buffer to spaces and copies an uppercase string into it.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:92CA
name: stub_empty_routine_entry_b
description: The routine body is a single instruction that only returns, so it has no logic to describe.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:92EC
name: format_text_line_entry_point
description: Calls a routine, clears the shared text buffer to spaces and copies an uppercase text string into it, adding a period when the text is too long.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:92F8
name: show_countdown_message_a
description: When a shared countdown is zero it calls a routine. Otherwise it decrements the countdown, stores the current position and a derived offset, then calls a routine and formats a status line.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:9346
name: show_countdown_message_b
description: When a second shared countdown is zero it calls a routine. Otherwise it decrements the countdown, stores the current position and a derived offset, then calls a routine and formats a status line.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:9394
name: step_digit_counter_and_format
description: Decrements a shared character digit, wrapping it back to two when it passes zero, increments a shared step counter and formats a status line.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:9406
name: advance_sequence_stage
description: Increments a stage counter in the record. At five it calls a stored handler, resets the counter and sets state words. At two it runs a different step.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:944E
name: reset_sequence_stage_state
description: Calls a stored handler, clears a stage counter and sets state words, then calls routines and formats a status line.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:947C
name: set_flag_and_format_status
description: Sets a shared flag byte, calls a stored handler and formats a status line.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:9492
name: set_state_words_and_format
description: Sets shared state words, calls a stored handler and formats a status line.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:94B4
name: set_state_words_format_alt
description: Sets shared state words, calls a stored handler and formats a status line.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:9518
name: call_stored_handler_passthrough
description: Calls a stored handler and returns its two input values unchanged.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:952A
name: call_routine_passthrough
description: Calls a routine and returns its two input values unchanged.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:953C
name: save_call_and_restore_word
description: Saves a word from the record, calls a stored handler, writes fill bytes while a flag in the record is set, then restores the saved word.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:959A
name: clear_status_and_call_handler
description: Clears a status byte and calls a stored handler.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:95A4
name: cycle_digit_and_format_text
description: Cycles a shared counter through the values one to three, writes it as a digit into a shared text buffer and formats the line.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:95F0
name: cycle_pointer_table_and_format
description: Cycles an index through a four-entry table, writes the selected pointer into the record and formats a status line.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:95F2
name: cycle_pointer_table_format_alt
description: Cycles an index through a four-entry table, writes the selected pointer into the record and formats a status line after an extra call.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:9686
name: compute_angular_position_offsets
description: Calls ten routines, then derives a position from a scaled angle in a 360-step turn and offsets it into the record.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:96BA
name: update_slots_from_shared_scratch
description: Calls four routines and, when a shared counter is positive, decrements it and writes scratch values from shared tables into slot entries.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:96F0
name: update_slots_from_scratch_b
description: Updates slot entries from shared scratch tables when a shared counter is positive, decrementing the counter and writing bit masks into a display block.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:9798
name: update_slots_from_scratch_c
description: Updates slot entries from shared scratch tables when a shared counter is positive, decrementing the counter and writing bit masks into a display block.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:9834
name: dispatch_pending_slot_handlers
description: When a shared mode value is zero, selects a pending slot record and calls a series of routines to update it. Otherwise it dispatches to the alternate slot's handlers.
